title: Mysterious Visitor
next_chapter_hook: The token lay quietly in his palm, its patterns identical to those on the Turtle Shell artifact—A terrible thought surged in Chen Ji's heart: the Heavenly Secrets Pavilion's layout extended far deeper than he could have imagined.

text.content: Mist wound around his feet like gauze, and Chen Ji followed Chen Nian through layers of impenetrable chaos. His spiritual awareness remained highly vigilant, every step hiding an escape route. His sister, missing for years, had suddenly appeared, bringing a mysterious benefactor—these strange circumstances demanded clarity.

dialogue.emotion: 平静中带着一丝难以察觉的紧绷

text.content: Chen Nian's voice pulled Chen Ji back to the present. He noticed his sister's silhouette was much thinner than in his memory, her shoulder blades visible even through her clothes. What had the Holy Sect done to her all these years? The question was like a thorn, deeply embedded in his heart.

The mist ahead suddenly parted as if drawn by an invisible hand, revealing an ancient stone pavilion. A woman sat within, appearing around thirty years of age, with features like a painting. Yet her aura was ethereal and inscrutable, as if she might dissolve into the Void at any moment.

dialogue.content: This is the benefactor I mentioned—the Gate Guardian of the Heavenly Secrets Pavilion.

text.content: Chen Ji's pupils contracted. Heavenly Secrets Pavilion? These three words were not unfamiliar to him—legends spoke of a mysterious force that stood above all sects, one even the Heavenly Eye would regard with caution. But from what he knew, the Heavenly Secrets Pavilion had been destroyed in the cataclysm a thousand years ago. How could any successors possibly still exist?

dialogue.content: You have doubts. That is perfectly normal.

text.content: The woman spoke slowly, her voice cold as mountain spring water, yet carrying an inexplicable penetrating power, as if resonating directly within one's soul.

dialogue.content: The Heavenly Secrets Pavilion has never perished. What you see as the world is merely one corner of a chessboard.

text.content: Chen Ji's heart shook violently. One corner of a chessboard? What did that mean? He unconsciously clenched his fists, though his face retained that harmless, timid expression. Only he knew that his mind was racing through countless possibilities.

dialogue.content: You thought the Heavenly Eye was the master of this realm? It is merely a discarded piece from the Heavenly Secrets Pavilion, and the incomplete Tianji Record in your hands was originally a secret treasure that slipped away from the Pavilion.

text.content: These words exploded like thunder in Chen Ji's Mental Sea. The Heavenly Eye—that lofty existence he had once thought untouchable—was actually a castoff of the Heavenly Secrets Pavilion? The Tianji Record wasn't a fortuitous opportunity he'd stumbled upon, but had an inexplicable connection to him from the very beginning?

choice.prompt: How should Chen Ji respond to the shocking truth revealed by the Gate Guardian?

choices.text: Inquire About the Terms of Exchange
choices.description: Since the other party came seeking him, they must want something. Better to hear their conditions first.
choices.visible_reward: Fourth Page of the Tianji Record
choices.risk_hint: The Heavenly Secrets Pavilion's kindness often comes with an even greater price

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, forcing himself to calm down. He understood only too well—in this chess game, there are no unearned favors. If the other party dared call themselves the Gate Guardian of the Heavenly Secrets Pavilion, the price they demanded would certainly not be simple.

choices.text: Press for the Truth About the Heavenly Secrets Pavilion
choices.description: Before making any decision, he must understand more inside information.
choices.risk_hint: The Gate Guardian's patience may not be sufficient

text.content: Chen Ji slightly bent forward, assuming a modest, seeking-posture: "Since the senior knows the origins of the Tianji Record, you surely also know its dangers. I dare to ask—since the Heavenly Secrets Pavilion has transcended worldly affairs, why intervene in the struggles of this realm?"

choices.description: Heavenly Secrets Pavilion, surpassing the Heavenly Eye—these revelations came too conveniently. He had to be on guard.
choices.risk_hint: Being Overly Cautious May Miss Opportunities

text.content: Chen Ji lowered his eyes, fingers secretly gripping a transmission talisman within his sleeve. This was his last resort—if the person before him made any suspicious move, he would retreat at the first opportunity. No matter how temptingly she spoke, he would not be easily fooled.

The Gate Guardian's lips curved slightly upward, her smile carrying a playful quality. She gently raised her hand, and an arcane rune appeared in the Void. At its center, the faint outline of an ancient page was visible—its aura was identical to the Tianji Record Fragment in Chen Ji's Mental Sea.

dialogue.content: This is the Fourth Page of the Tianji Record. If you complete one task for the Heavenly Secrets Pavilion, it will be yours.

text.content: Chen Ji's heart raced. The Fourth Page of the Tianji Record—he understood only too well what this meant. Each fragment page contained the power to transform the world. The third page granted him the ability to foresee the future. What would the fourth page bring?

choice.prompt: Facing the temptation of the Fourth Page of the Tianji Record, what choice should Chen Ji make?

choices.description: First hear what the mission is, then decide. There is no free lunch in this world.
choices.risk_hint: Mission difficulty is unknown; it may be a one-way trip

text.content: Chen Ji did not immediately agree. Instead, he asked in a steady voice: "May I ask what mission would require a senior of your status to come in person?" He understood only too well—the richer the reward, often the greater the danger.

choices.description: Let him see the Fourth Page's authenticity first, then discuss anything else.
choices.visible_reward: Confirm the Authenticity of the Fortune
choices.risk_hint: Being Too Eager May Expose Weaknesses

text.content: Chen Ji stared directly at the rune, his gaze冷静而锐利—cold and sharp: "I am ignorant and inexperienced, not knowing if what the senior says is true or false. May I be permitted to examine it, to verify your words?" His tone was calm, but骨子里透着一股不容置疑的底气—bone-deep, there was an unquestionable resolve.

choices.description: The waters of the Heavenly Secrets Pavilion run too deep. He did not want to stumble blindly into this murky mess.
choices.risk_hint: May Completely Offend the Heavenly Secrets Pavilion

text.content: Chen Ji lowered his eyes, assuming an expression of anxiety: "How could I, with my limited virtue, possibly bear the senior's heavy entrustment?" His mind raced with calculations—retreating now might be the wisest choice, but was this truly a wise decision?

dialogue.content: The mission is simple—retrieve the last fragment of the Heavenly Eye's source that was scattered in the lower realm.

text.content: Retrieve the Source Fragment? Chen Ji's heart tightened. This meant he would face the Heavenly Eye directly—that existence he had once thought utterly beyond reach. A chill rose along his spine, but there was also an inexplicable excitement. This chess game was becoming more and more interesting.

dialogue.content: Rest assured, the Heavenly Secrets Pavilion will not send you to your death for nothing. That Source Fragment lies deep within the Ancient Forbidden Land, and all you need to do is bring it out. Nothing more.

text.content: As the Gate Guardian finished speaking, an ancient token appeared before Chen Ji out of thin air. The token was entirely black, its front carved with an ancient rune, surrounded by intricate patterns—patterns identical to those on the Turtle Shell artifact in Chen Ji's possession!

dialogue.content: This is the Heavenly Token. It can shield you from the Heavenly Eye's perception within the Ancient Forbidden Land. As for the exact location of the Source Fragment—when the time is right, it will guide you.

text.content: Chen Ji slowly extended his hand. The moment his fingertips touched the token, a cold aura rushed along his meridians directly into his Mental Sea. That aura was ancient and profound, as if carrying the weight of millennia. A scene flashed through his mind—in the endless Void, a giant eye was watching him.

Chen Ji withdrew his hand, his expression unchanged. Only he knew what he had glimpsed in that instant. That eye—the Heavenly Eye—seemed to have sensed something, searching along some kind of trail. And the existence of the Heavenly Token seemed capable of concealing precisely this aura.

choice.prompt: The truth of the Heavenly Token shocked Chen Ji, but he needed to make a final decision.

choices.description: Since there is a means of protection, might as well take the leap. Fortune favors the bold!
choices.visible_cost: Become Enemies with the Heavenly Eye
choices.visible_reward: Fourth Page of Tianji Record + Heavenly Token
choices.risk_hint: The Heavenly Eye's backlash may exceed expectations

text.content: Chen Ji tucked the Heavenly Token into his chest, a flash of determination in his eyes. If the Heavenly Secrets Pavilion wished to place him upon this chessboard, then he would ride the momentum and carve a bloody path through this game. What was the Heavenly Eye to him? Chen Ji had never feared any opponent.

choices.description: This exchange cannot consist solely of his付出—there must be some guarantee secured for his sister as well.
choices.risk_hint: The Gate Guardian may consider him greedy

text.content: Chen Ji gripped the token in his palm, his gaze平静地看向守门人—calmly fixed on the Gate Guardian: "I can accept this mission, but with one condition—my sister Chen Nian must receive the protection of the Heavenly Secrets Pavilion." His tone brooked no argument. In that moment, that废物弟子—the useless disciple who appeared timid and incompetent before others—had an令人心悸的锋芒—a chilling sharpness flickering in his eyes.

dialogue.content: He is protective of his own. Interesting... I accept your condition.

text.content: The Gate Guardian's form began to fade, as if she might dissolve into the Void at any moment. She cast Chen Ji a final glance, her eyes flickering with a profound light.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji, I hope when we meet again, you are still alive. The Heavenly Secrets Pavilion's chess game has been laid out, and you—have entered the board.

text.content: Her words faded, and mist surged back, completely engulfing that stone pavilion. Chen Ji stood in place, the Heavenly Token gripped tightly in his hand. The patterns on the token perfectly matched those on the Turtle Shell artifact—this discovery stirred a terrible thought in his heart: the Heavenly Secrets Pavilion's layout extended far deeper than he could have imagined. And he—had been chosen from the very beginning.
